success.description: The necromancer's touch rots wood and leather, corrodes metal, or withers flesh, reducing the quality of an item touched to poor. If the target is a creature, it takes 4+St {Dc} damage

boon.description: The soak value of target armour, damage rating of target weapon, or other relevant statistics is reduced by 1. This can affect an item worn or carried by the target of the GM's choice

sigmarsComet.description: A non-magical, non-living object is completely destroyed

conservative.requirements: Power, engaged with target. Special: This action is also a Melee Attack
